build_dataloader: build a train and validation dataloader from a PyTorch dataset with a configurable train split ratio
build_test_dataloader: build a test dataloader from a PyTorch dataset with a specified batch size and collate function
build_metrics: build ignite metrics including loss and top-k categorical accuracy for attribute, leaf, and all token predictions
train: train a code prediction transformer model with Adam optimizer, early stopping, and model checkpointing
eval_model: evaluate a trained code prediction transformer model on a test dataset and log metrics to a file
